verdict.rationale: Loops documents a broad API covering contacts, events, transactional email, campaigns, email content, themes, and workflow graphs (create, branch, edit, and delete nodes). It also offers an OpenAPI spec, a CLI, and an MCP server that reach the same API. However, its own docs say campaigns are created as drafts via the API and then reviewed and sent from the dashboard, so full UI parity is contradicted. Missing for 10: API-side campaign sending, evidence of API coverage for segments, domain setup, and team or settings management, and independent hands-on confirmation of parity.
